purpose: Deterministic confidence in technical assessment completeness and provenance. It is not an LLM confidence score and not a probability of business impact.

formula.method: weighted sum of factors after excluding factors declared unavailable; return null when contributing weight coverage is below minimum_factor_weight_coverage

rule_coverage.method: sum of configured weights for completed or completed_with_warnings selected rules divided by configured weights for selected applicable rules

metric_coverage.method: available approved primary metrics divided by applicable approved primary metrics, weighted by scoring policy rule weights
metric_coverage.unavailable_when: no approved primary metrics are applicable

evidence_coverage.method: min(1, retained evidence collections with provenance divided by configured minimum supporting evidence collections), subject to evidence truncation penalty

source_provenance.method: 1 when Understanding and Execution source fingerprints, run linkage, rule registry fingerprint and source contract versions are present and consistent; 0 otherwise

external_context_coverage.method: verified citations divided by planned required citations, capped at 1; 0 when a complete report requires external context but no verified citation is available
external_context_coverage.unavailable_when: business-impact mapping declares no external context necessary
